theme_strategy.tone: Direct, calm, concise, professional, no hype, no false certainty, highly legible, teenage-friendly yet mature
theme_strategy.aesthetic_archetype: Performance Pro + Swiss High-Contrast hybrid with Tactical Teal accents

components: Brand logo 'TradeWise' with tactical teal badge
Market Region Switch (ASX 🇦🇺 vs US 🇺🇸 with real-time open/closed status)
Tab Navigation bar (Today, Analyse, Follow, My Trades, Learn)
Quick Status Indicator (P&L summary & Active Positions count)

layout_and_navigation.mobile: Bottom navigation bar for 5 key tabs with high tap target (min 44px) + responsive drawer for extra actions
layout_and_navigation.desktop: Top sticky navigation bar with glassmorphism backdrop (backdrop-blur-md bg-opacity-80)

sections: Market Status Banner: Market index trends (S&P 500 / ASX 200), VIX volatility meter, upcoming catalyst events (CPI, Fed, Earnings), last updated timestamp
What Traders Are Watching: Up to 3 curated setups (Ticker, Trader name, concise reasoning, price condition, risk level, source badge, freshness timestamp)
Stocks Worth Reviewing: Filterable list with volume spike indicators, RVOL, key support/resistance proximity
My Positions: Active holdings summary with live simulated price, P&L, stop distance visual gauge
Quick Actions Bar: Log Trade, Run AI Analysis, Import Setup, Review Flagged Trades
Trades Needing Review: Flagged trades from previous sessions requiring post-trade notes or review
Interactive Trade Analysis Form: Ticker, Direction (Long/Short), Entry Price, Quantity, Target, Stop Loss, Date, Notes, Setup Category
AI Assessment Engine: What Looks Positive, What Could Go Wrong, What Might Happen Next, What to Check Before Deciding
Scenario Generator: Bullish / Base / Bearish probabilities with interactive price target visualization
Key Levels & Catalysts: Support/Resistance table, news Sentiment summary, Uncertainty Meter
Expandable 'Why?' Deep-Dive Accordion: Transparent AI reasoning breakdown without technical jargon
Save Assessment CTA & Copy to Practice Journal button
What Would Have Happened (Historical Backtest Check): Select past trade entry date to evaluate outcome against historical candles
Trader Source Toggles: TraderTV Live, SMB Capital, Bear Bull Traders (toggle on/off feed filtering)
Latest Feed Stream: Setup cards with freshness status labels ('Fresh - 8m ago', 'Developing - 1h ago', 'Stale - 4h ago')
Evidence Scorecard: Visual meter for Risk/Reward ratio, Catalyst strength, Trend confluence, Volume confirmation
Telegram / Discord Paste Import Tool: Raw text parser that auto-extracts Ticker, Entry, Stop, Target, Reasoning from pasted trader messages
Manual Setup Entry Modal
One-click 'Copy to Practice Journal'
Trade Type Segmentation Tabs: All Trades | Actual Account | Simulated / Paper | Hypothetical
Performance Summary Bar: Total P&L, Win Rate %, Average R:R Ratio, Total Trades, Best Setup Category
Interactive Trades Journal Table: Search, Filter by Type/Status/Ticker, Sort by Date/P&L
Detailed Trade Card / Modal: Entry, Exit, P&L, Risk/Reward achieved, AI Review badge, Strategy Tags, Retrospective reflection notes
Category Filters: Risk & Position Sizing, Market Structure, Execution & VWAP, Trading Psychology & Discipline, Order Types
Article Cards: Bite-sized, direct concept guides (reading time ~2-3 mins, crisp key takeaways, clear diagrams, zero jargon or hype)
Search & Saved Guides

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the app is 100% action-first, modern, clean, and highly responsive.
Implement the 5 tabs clearly: Today, Analyse, Follow, My Trades, Learn.
Include Market Selection switch (ASX vs US) with state persistence across tabs.
Implement real working interactive forms, search filters, state persistence in localStorage/state so the user can test full user journeys.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive controls (buttons, inputs, tabs, selects, cards).
Use Lucide icons for high quality visual indicators (e.g., TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck, Zap, Activity, BookOpen, Clock, Target, ArrowUpRight).
Never execute real orders; clearly display disclaimers that TradeWise is an analytical decision support tool.
